title: 人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の推進に関する法律 (Act No. 53 of 2025 — AI Promotion Act Full Statutory Text)

covered_actors: National government and national administrative organs
Research and development institutions (universities, R&D corporations, and other AI R&D bodies)
AI utilizing businesses (developers, providers, and business users of AI-related products or services)

evidence.quote: 人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用は、不正な目的又は不適切な方法で行われた場合には、犯罪への利用、個人情報の漏えい、著作権の侵害その他の国民生活の平穏及び国民の権利利益が害される事態を助長するおそれがあることに鑑み、その適正な実施を図るため、人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の過程の透明性の確保その他の必要な施策が講じられなければならない。
evidence.quote_en: In light of the risk that research, development, and utilization of AI-related technologies, if conducted for improper purposes or by inappropriate methods, may foster situations that harm the tranquility of citizens' lives and citizens' rights and interests—such as use in crime, leakage of personal information, or infringement of copyright—measures necessary to ensure transparency in the processes of research, development, and utilization of AI-related technologies and other necessary measures must be taken to ensure their proper implementation.

evidence.quote: 国は、国内外の人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の動向に関する情報の収集、不正な目的又は不適切な方法による人工知能関連技術の研究開発又は活用に伴って国民の権利利益の侵害が生じた事案の分析及びそれに基づく対策の検討その他の人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の推進に資する調査及び研究を行い、その結果に基づいて、研究開発機関、活用事業者その他の者に対する指導、助言、情報の提供その他の必要な措置を講ずるものとする。
evidence.quote_en: The State shall conduct investigations and research contributing to the promotion of R&D and utilization of AI-related technologies—including collecting information on domestic and foreign trends, analyzing cases where citizens' rights and interests were infringed due to R&D or utilization of AI-related technologies for improper purposes or by inappropriate methods, and examining countermeasures based thereon—and, based on the results, shall take necessary measures such as guidance, advice, and provision of information to R&D institutions, utilizing business operators, and other persons.

evidence.quote: 人工知能関連技術を活用した製品又はサービスの開発又は提供をしようとする者その他の人工知能関連技術を事業活動において活用しようとする者（以下「活用事業者」という。）は、基本理念にのっとり、自ら積極的な人工知能関連技術の活用により事業活動の効率化及び高度化並びに新産業の創出に努めるとともに、第四条の規定に基づき国が実施する施策及び第五条の規定に基づき地方公共団体が実施する施策に協力しなければならない。
evidence.quote_en: Persons who intend to develop or provide products or services utilizing AI-related technologies and other persons who intend to utilize AI-related technologies in business activities (hereinafter referred to as 'utilizing business operators') shall, in accordance with the basic principles, strive to improve the efficiency and sophistication of business activities and create new industries through proactive utilization of AI-related technologies, and shall cooperate with measures implemented by the State pursuant to Article 4 and by local governments pursuant to Article 5.

evidence.quote: 国は、人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の適正な実施を図るため、国際的な規範の趣旨に即した指針の整備その他の必要な施策を講ずるものとする。
evidence.quote_en: In order to ensure the proper implementation of research, development, and utilization of AI-related technologies, the State shall develop guidelines in line with the purport of international norms and take other necessary measures.

evidence.quote: その結果に基づいて、研究開発機関、活用事業者その他の者に対する指導、助言、情報の提供その他の必要な措置を講ずるものとする。
evidence.quote_en: Based on the results thereof, the State shall provide guidance, advice, information, and take other necessary measures toward R&D institutions, utilizing business operators, and other persons.

compliance_deadlines: Date of promulgation: entry into force of general provisions (Supplementary Provisions Article 1)
Within 3 months of promulgation (date specified by Cabinet Order): entry into force of Chapters 3 and 4 (AI Basic Plan and AI Strategy Headquarters) and Supplementary Provisions Articles 3 and 4
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Act No. 53 of 2025 (Reiwa 7) is a horizontal statutory framework promoting AI R&D and utilization alongside proper governance. It establishes the Cabinet-level AI Strategy Headquarters (supported by the Cabinet Office) and mandates an AI Basic Plan (Article 18). While utilizing businesses are legally required to cooperate with government measures (Article 7), the Act relies on soft supervisory tools—such as incident investigation, analysis, guidance, advice, and information provision (Article 16)—and contains no statutory fines or criminal penalties. Supplementary Provisions Article 2 requires the government to review implementation status in light of international trends and socioeconomic changes.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: Japan's AI Promotion Act (Act No. 53 of 2025) is predominantly framed around innovation enablement: its core purpose (Article 1) and operative provisions (Articles 3, 4, 6, 7, 11–15) focus on comprehensively promoting end-to-end AI R&D, public-sector and private-sector adoption, shared compute and data infrastructure, talent development, and light-touch guidelines aligned with international norms. Innovation enablement edges out economic competitiveness because the statute's overarching structure emphasizes domestic ecosystem building, administrative and business efficiency, and trustworthy utilization rather than purely zero-sum global rivalry, although economic competitiveness is a strong runner-up explicitly anchored in Article 3(2)'s mandate to create new industries and enhance international industrial competitiveness. Fundamental rights and national security serve as clear secondary frames: Article 3(4) and Article 16 address protecting citizens' rights and interests (such as personal information and copyright) against improper AI use, while Article 3(2) explicitly recognizes AI as important from a national security perspective requiring retention of domestic R&D capability. Criminal misuse and the peace of citizens' lives in Article 3(4) introduce minor consumer/public safety and social stability elements, whereas existential risk and labor transition are absent.

evidence_spans.quote: 人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の推進に関する施策の総合的かつ計画的な推進を図り、もって国民生活の向上及び国民経済の健全な発展に寄与することを目的とする。
evidence_spans.quote_en: The purpose of this Act is to promote policies for the research, development, and utilization of AI-related technologies in a comprehensive and planned manner, thereby contributing to the improvement of citizens' lives and the sound development of the national economy.

evidence_spans.quote: 人工知能関連技術が、その適正かつ効果的な活用によって行政事務及び民間の事業活動の著しい効率化及び高度化並びに新産業の創出をもたらすものとして経済社会の発展の基盤となる技術である
evidence_spans.quote_en: AI-related technologies are foundational technologies for economic and social development that, through proper and effective utilization, bring about remarkable efficiency and advancement in administrative affairs and private business activities as well as the creation of new industries.

evidence_spans.quote: 我が国において人工知能関連技術の研究開発を行う能力を保持するとともに、人工知能関連技術に関する産業の国際競争力を向上させることを旨として、行うものとする。
evidence_spans.quote_en: It shall be carried out with the aim of maintaining Japan's capacity to conduct research and development of AI-related technologies and improving the international competitiveness of industries related to AI-related technologies.

evidence_spans.quote: 経済社会の発展の基盤となる技術であるとともに、安全保障の観点からも重要な技術であることに鑑み、我が国において人工知能関連技術の研究開発を行う能力を保持する
evidence_spans.quote_en: In view of the fact that AI-related technologies are foundational to economic and social development as well as important technologies from the perspective of national security, Japan shall maintain its capacity to conduct research and development of AI-related technologies.

evidence_spans.quote: 不正な目的又は不適切な方法で行われた場合には、犯罪への利用、個人情報の漏えい、著作権の侵害その他の国民生活の平穏及び国民の権利利益が害される事態を助長するおそれがあることに鑑み、その適正な実施を図るため、人工知能関連技術の研究開発及び活用の過程の透明性の確保その他の必要な施策が講じられなければならない。
evidence_spans.quote_en: In view of the risk that, if conducted for improper purposes or by inappropriate methods, the R&D and utilization of AI-related technologies may foster use in crime, leakage of personal information, copyright infringement, and other situations harming the tranquility of citizens' lives and citizens' rights and interests, transparency and other necessary measures shall be taken to ensure proper implementation.

evidence_spans.quote: 不正な目的又は不適切な方法による人工知能関連技術の研究開発又は活用に伴って国民の権利利益の侵害が生じた事案の分析及びそれに基づく対策の検討
evidence_spans.quote_en: Analysis of cases in which infringement of citizens' rights and interests has occurred in connection with the R&D or utilization of AI-related technologies for improper purposes or by inappropriate methods, and examination of countermeasures based thereon.
